thread:
Maya: Quick pitch 1 run a tiny 'starter boost' pilot tied to the live workshop next month. Give 50 starter tokens + a curated prompt template pack to first-time attendees who register and show. KPI: 7-day activation >=5 API calls or 1 completed chat flow.

Jon: Sounds good. Need clear experiment arms: control / email-only / email+in-app nudge.

Elaine: Routing idea 1 email to registrants, in-product banner for signed-in RSVPers, claim link for non-signed-up registrants in the welcome flow.

Sam: I'll set up Amplitude cohorts, randomize at RSVP to avoid bias. Need event list and properties.

Maya: Proposed arms:
- A: baseline (no extra outreach)
- B: email-only (subject + CTA to claim)
- C: email + in-app banner + auto-insert promptpack on first session
Window: gifts redeemable for 14 days after workshop. Measure 7-day and 14-day activation and retention.

Jon: Email subject note: avoid the word 'free' for compliance. Options: "Your Redwood starter toolkit 1 for workshop attendees" or "Starter kit inside: templates + tokens". Lean to the first.

Elaine: I'll draft email copy and two banner variants (short + extended). Include 1-2 exemplar prompts in the email so value is immediate.

Sam: Event list I'm capturing: workshop_registered, workshop_attended, starter_claimed (prop: arm), first_api_call (prop: success), prompt_template_used (prop: template_id), tour_started, tour_completed. Also track user_cohort (A/B/C) and signup_source. Will add utm_* props for attribution.

devex-bot: Dev note 1 promo tokens single-use, TTL 14d. Use POST /promo/generate with marketing-scoped key. Landing URL pattern: /starter/claim/<code>. Landing fires starter_claimed and redirects to quickstart with promptpack preloaded.

Maya: Can we auto-show a small overlay after claim with 3 exemplar prompts + a "run one now" CTA? Track overlay_shown and overlay_action.

Jon: Add telemetry: overlay_shown, overlay_action (run_now/copy_prompt). Also I'll QA email + banner on Thursday.

Sam: I'll produce sample-size calc and tentative funnel targets: aim for 20% claim rate on arm C, 8-10% on email-only, baseline 3-5%. Target +10pp 7-day activation lift vs control. Will formalize by EOD Friday.

Elaine: Drafts go to marketing drive; will drop link here and tag legal for token language signoff.

Maya: Quick checklist: [ ] Amplitude spec (Sam) [ ] Promo generation + keys (devex-bot) [ ] Landing + analytics (devex-bot) [ ] Email + banner copy (Elaine) [ ] Promptpack + exemplar prompts (Maya) [ ] Legal review (Elaine/Legal) [ ] QA plan (Jon).

Jon: Add UTM matrix: utm_medium=workshop, utm_campaign=starter_toolkit, utm_variant=A/B/C.

Sam: Noted, will include utm props in event schema.

Maya: If all agree, lock arms tomorrow and schedule a 20m sync after Elaine posts drafts.

Elaine: Posting drafts Wed 11am PT, will @legal.

Jon: :thumbsup:
